text: Who do you want to sing for?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: Oh, basically just me, myself. Maybe later, when I have a girlfriend, or in specific situations — like on someone's birthday, I would sing a birthday song for them. Or on Father's Day or Mother's Day, I would sing for my parents. But most of the time, I just sing for myself, to express my feelings.
